comments.author: VanillaMammoth1937
comments.body:
I mean, you're still using the art style that every single vibe coded UI in the world is using (everything is a rectangle with rounded corners and translucent interiors, emojis used often, minimalist aesthetic). I support AI use in game dev and even then I'm pretty tired of seeing this everywhere.

No shade to you since a ton of people do this, but I would reccommend you switch it up.

replies.author: HoboSteeveJacko
replies.body:
I mean I hear you, but it's not just AI vibe code that uses these styles. Its been a part of gaming for a decade or more. Especially if your main complaint is about the minimalist aesthetic. 

Its simple because its a puzzle gameboard game. Adding unnecessary details makes understanding the gameboard more difficult, not to mention the generic look is to be more inclusive. If I did runes as the tokens and a marble grid it limits potential players who enjoy that aesthetic. This being simple and clean doesn't lean into a specific direction to fit better with the kind of game it is. 

I've also asked this many times when people bring up how simple the aesthetic is. I would love to hear suggestions of something that would be an improvement. Most people can say that there's a problem, but couldn't suggest what a solution would look like. Or what would be good. Also no shade but Ive got to explain my decisions because AI didn't decide my art style. I specifically picked shapes, colors, font decisions, UI decisions, made my own emojis, ect. 

Thank you for your feedback, I hope to hear more. I appreciate your time and opinions.
